### 5 Inspiring Lessons from the Life (and Death) of Dorcas
Author: Heather Adams
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/women/inspiring-lessons-from-the-life-and-death-of-dorcas.html
Passage: Acts 9:36
Points:
- Use your personal skills and everyday talents to meet practical needs around you.
- Stay faithful in quiet acts of charity, trusting God to expand their impact.
- Invest in Christ-centered relationships that leave an enduring legacy of love.
- Make humble service an immediate priority rather than waiting for ideal circumstances.
- Let your daily conduct and life challenges serve as a living testimony for God's glory.

### How One Woman Built a Church that Lasted
Author: Rebekah Montgomery
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/church/pastors-or-leadership/how-one-woman-built-a-church-that-lasted-11575389.html
Passage: Acts 9:36-37
Points:
- Simple acts of kindness done in Jesus' name carry lasting power to change lives.
- God places high value on practical gifts used to serve marginalized and vulnerable people.
- Ministry does not require a pulpit or prominent title to build Christ's church.
- Dorcas' faithful example continues to inspire practical ministry to the needy today.
